headline: Four Coinbase Executives Exit Or Shift Roles In Just Over Two Weeks
summary: Chief Legal Officer Paul Grewal will also be leaving, while Jesse Pollak is stepping back from leading the Base app due to unmet strategic goals.

headline: Strategy (MSTR) Joins BlackRock And Coinbase In Bitcoin Security Consortium
summary: Strategy (NasdaqGS:MSTR) has joined BlackRock, Coinbase, and other industry players to form the Bitcoin Security Consortium. The consortium is focused on strengthening Bitcoin against potential quantum computing threats. Members have committed a combined US$15 million to support research and development of quantum resistant security measures.
